en.title: Trump offers UFC CEO Dana White White House press secretary role after 2026 midterms
en.dek: President Trump offered the White House press secretary position to UFC chief Dana White, who said he will meet with Trump on Monday to discuss the appointment.

White said he will meet with Trump on Monday to discuss the offer, according to Al Jazeera and ABC7 Los Angeles

body: On November 8, 2026, President Donald Trump offered the White House press secretary role to Ultimate Fighting Championship CEO Dana White, according to The Washington Post, Sky News and DW.com.
White said he will meet with Trump on Monday to discuss the offer, according to Al Jazeera and ABC7 Los Angeles.
The Kremlin called the question of whether the new Congress would challenge Trump's stance on Russia and Ukraine an internal matter for the US, according to The Hindu and The Washington Post.

President Donald Trump ordered the US Justice Department on Saturday to look into Democrats for threatening a lot of people with impeachment and other forms of punishment, according to Dawn and The Hindu.
Congressional Democrats are preparing a new military aid package for Ukraine worth approximately $15 billion, according to reports from The Kyiv Post and UNITED24 Media.
Dana White said he will meet with President Trump on Monday to discuss the offer to become White House press secretary, according to The Hill and France 24.
en.context: Following the 2026 US midterm elections, President Trump has made several appointments and policy announcements, including offering the White House press secretary role to UFC CEO Dana White and ordering the Justice Department to investigate Democrats over impeachment threats.
